summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built and deployed production voice AI applications in Python, integrating streaming ASR, LLM intent classification, and REST/WebSocket APIs across a distributed three-layer pipeline. Experienced debugging live integration failures end to end, from API and network layers through model behavior, and leading technical teams to ship on deadline.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% on a structured field-extraction task through preprocessing redesign and model tuning.

Fine-tuned DONUT, an OCR-free document-understanding transformer, building preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch on the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API with domain-specific special tokens.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced member; took over as team lead mid-project to restructure task distribution and deliver a full U-Net segmentation pipeline within a 6-week window.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI (PyQt, Matplotlib) for real-time data acquisition and visualization in a live laboratory environment; used GitLab and JupyterHub for collaborative analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member technical team across national-level competitions and organized 10+ exhibitions and hands-on workshops, teaching technical tooling to non-specialist audiences.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — M.S. Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a production voice AI application over a three-layer distributed pipeline: Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson controller linked by a unified WebSocket fabric.
Integrated faster-whisper streaming STT (1.0–1.4s) and Gemini API intent classification (<500ms) with TensorRT-optimized YOLO vision (5.2x speedup, 56.7 to 10.9 ms) for closed-loop visual servoing.
Debugged and resolved 11 integration failures spanning false-positive detections, power brown-out, and stale-frame capture; achieved 100% task reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

projects.name: Whisper-Style ASR Engine from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline with an 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder and 4-block causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention; achieved 15% WER on an accented Hindi-English dataset.
Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython-accelerated backend achieving 4-5.5x speedup over pure Python, processing 6M characters in 15 minutes.

projects.name: LLM Compression and Benchmarking for Production Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml.
Benchmarked on HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC with under 1% accuracy loss, establishing near-lossless compression.
